diagnostic.animation-canary.gates: every animation mod (12) -- decides whether composite_redirect can carry an animation slice at all
diagnostic.animation-canary.test: FIRST, before GFTime Dance. Install, restart, and just tell me whether you reach the character screen -- do not test the dance. These 12 slices are re-serialised and redirected through the identical route with every animation byte unchanged from vanilla, so a crash means the route itself cannot carry an animation slice, and a clean boot means the earlier fatal was the x32 payload data. Uninstalling in the launcher restores everything.
